section_summary.extract_value: This introduction highlights the global prevalence of loneliness, citing statistics from the United States (43% feel isolated, 46% feel lonely) and China (one study on 64,000 participants found 90% feel lonely). It discusses loneliness as a risk factor for premature mortality and its correlation with suicide. The paper aims to analyze the psychological well-being of Chinese international students and explore factors that mitigate their loneliness.
